definitions: A room or a set of rooms forming a separate residence within a house or block of flats.
A large building divided into flats or apartments, especially one in a poorer area of a city.
Any kind of permanent property, such as land, houses, or other buildings.
examples: The family lived in a small tenement.
Many tenements were built in the 19th century.
The legal document referred to the tenement as part of the estate.
